description.purpose: Operational costs rolled up to one row per month, with COGS/R&D/G&A breakdown columns. Source of the monthly totals that operational_cost_per_user divides across users acquired that month. All amounts are EUR.

schema.description: Operational costs rolled up to one row per month, with COGS/R&D/G&A breakdown columns. Source of the monthly totals that operational_cost_per_user divides across users acquired that month. All amounts are EUR.
schema.name: operational_costs_monthly

properties.description: First day of the calendar month the costs fall in.
properties.name: cost_month

properties.description: Total operational cost for the month, in EUR, rounded to cents. Equals cogs_eur + rd_eur + ga_eur, and also equals variable_cost_eur + fixed_cost_eur.
properties.name: total_cost_eur

properties.description: The variable share (cloud hosting, transaction fees) of the month's operational cost, in EUR. The basis for the per-user variable_cost_eur that ltv_per_user subtracts from revenue to get contribution margin.
properties.name: variable_cost_eur

properties.description: The fixed share (e.g. salaries, customer support) of the month's operational cost, in EUR. Excluded from contribution margin in ltv_per_user; belongs in a fully-allocated view instead.
properties.name: fixed_cost_eur

properties.description: Number of cost-line seed rows rolled into this month.
properties.name: cost_line_count
